svg.aria-label: Document mutation lifecycle. How an optimistic document update becomes durable state and is optionally published through Git.
svg.title: Superbee document mutation lifecycle
svg.desc: An agent or human invokes document read and update commands. Local and explicit remote routes converge on the core mutation transaction. A semantic no-op returns the current version, while a real change crosses a local atomic or remote HTTP compare-and-swap boundary and returns a new version. An optional later sync publishes the durable local state through a separate Git transaction.
